meta.title: Froggion — 24/7 AFK bots for game servers
meta.description: Rent AFK bots for Minecraft servers: mob grinding, fishing, auto-mining and auto-farming. Bots run around the clock on our servers and you control them from a web panel. 1 bot for 24 hours free.
meta.ogImageAlt: A floating island where Froggion bots mine, fish, farm and fight creepers

hero.title: AFK bots that keep working while you rest
hero.subtitle: They fight mobs, fish, mine and farm around the clock on our servers. You control them from a web panel on your computer or phone.

FroggyMiner.name: Miner Frog
FroggyMiner.description: Loves digging cobblestone, ores and diamonds, but most of all croak-quartz. For fun he goes fishing with Fisher Frog, catching fish and sipping ribbit root beer.

FroggyFisherman.name: Fisher Frog
FroggyFisherman.description: Can sit by the pond with a rod for hours. Catches fish, treasure and old boots, and dreams of an a-croak-rium of his own.

FroggyFarmer.name: Farmer Frog
FroggyFarmer.description: Plants wheat, carrots and potatoes and harvests right on schedule. In winter he pickles cucumbers and croak-ferments cabbage.

FroggySlayer.name: Warrior Frog
FroggySlayer.description: Guards the island from creepers and never misses. Says the best defense is a well-croak-ordinated offense.

items.q: Do I need to keep my computer on?
items.a: No. Bots run on our servers around the clock, and you control them from the web panel on your computer or phone.

items.q: How do I try it for free?
items.a: Sign in to the panel with Telegram or VK ID and start a trial bot: 1 bot for 24 hours, free.

items.q: What happens if the bot is kicked or the server restarts?
items.a: The bot reconnects by itself. If you like, it sends an alert to Telegram, VK or Discord.

items.q: How does the bot stay safe from other players?
items.a: Turn on auto-leave: the bot leaves the server when players come close, health runs low or chosen words appear in chat.

items.q: Do I need my own proxies?
items.a: No, a shared proxy pool is included in the price. For a dedicated address there is the Private IP upgrade.

items.q: Can I control several bots at once?
items.a: Yes. Build your own function from steps and run it on all bots at once.

Bulk prices apply to 30 days: from 2 bots — 109 ₽, from 5 — 105 ₽, from 10 — 99 ₽ per bot. A partner promo code gives 15% off, and from the 4th month of continuous renewal there is a 10% loyalty discount.

items.q: How do I become a partner?
items.a: Send an application. Once approved, you get your own promo code and a 10, 7.5 or 5% commission on payments from the players you bring, depending on volume. Payouts are weekly, from 200 ₽.
